system.description:
Whenever you fell an opponent, the victory stokes your bloodlust and prepares you for more carnage.

Prerequisite: Trandoshan

Effect: Whenever you reduce a target to 0 Hit Points, you gain a number of Bonus Hit Points equal to 5 + one-half your Character Level. Damage is subtracted from Bonus Hit Points first, and any Bonus Hit Points remaining at the end of the encounter are lost. Bonus Hit Points do not stack.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
